what-line: A LOOP is a few steps, played again with a change, until you are back where you started.
what-small: A LOOP uses one of these changes, or a few at once.
line-rotated: The same steps again, turned a half or a quarter turn.
line-reflected: The same steps again, reflected across one of four lines through the centre.
line-swapped: The same steps again, with your hands trading jobs.
line-inverted: Your hands take the same paths again. Every spin goes the other way.
line-rewound: The same steps again, backwards, back the way you came.
